summary: Completed frontend testing of TVUSVET medical/veterinary system. Successfully tested VET/HUMAN practice context switching, Dev Switcher functionality, and confirmed core infrastructure. Unable to complete full clinical document editor template filtering tests due to navigation flow limitations in test environment.

ui_bugs.issue: Patients are not persisting between Playwright sessions due to IndexedDB reset - expected behavior per agent notes
ui_bugs.selector: Patient cards disappear on page refresh

passed_tests: VET/HUMAN Dev Switcher toggles correctly between modes
LicenseContext successfully switches practice types with incrementalPatch (no CONFLICT errors)
Practice context updates modules correctly (VET: cardio, lab_vet vs HUMAN: ophthalmo_human)
Search placeholder text changes based on VET/HUMAN context
CSS @media print styles exist with no-print class and A4 formatting
Database initialization with master data (64 drugs, 36 templates, 67 lab references)
Patient creation modal works with name and weight fields
Application loads correctly with NexaClinq branding
action_item_for_main_agent: Template filtering functionality could not be fully verified due to navigation flow limitations in test environment. The clinical document editor route navigation needs to be tested manually or with a different approach to verify: 1) VET templates showing 'MEDICINA VETERINARIA' header with 7 templates, 2) Print button presence next to Save button, 3) Edit mode title/badge changes, 4) Save button text changes in edit mode.
